title: Finite Moments Do Not Make Tukey Depth Identify a Probability Law
description: Working paper giving a negative answer to the finite-expectation subquestion in Nagy–Schütt–Werner Problem 12. For each dimension d≥2 and fixed finite integer k≥1, there are distinct smooth, strictly positive densities with finite absolute k-th moments, equal mixed moments through degree k, and identical Tukey halfspace depth at every point. AI-assisted and internally reviewed; not externally peer reviewed.
